card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number that continues into more digits, such as 25,000 or 60. It is usually a threshold, range start, or measurement in doses, lab values or other quantities.

modes.label: Lab and dose thresholds
modes.description: Leading digit of a cutoff or dose value in label text, often before a range word or unit.

modes.label: General quantities
modes.description: Leading digit of an age, depth, speed or range in web text.
modes.example: Keeping relative humidity in the <<2>>5 percent to 60 percent range

card.writes: It promotes the next digit or a unit rather than words like 'to' or '±', which it suppresses, so the number is expected to keep going.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number whose remaining digits are still to come, especially a range start or cutoff.
